name: miadi-release-notes
description: A release note with the road ahead, written as a key moment of the session that made the release: what changed and for whom, the pull requests the next release carries (each test-merged into main), and what the sessions are working toward. Kept in the repository's RELEASE-NOTES.md, left as a beat on the episode's plot thread, and sent by the factory's mail to the people it concerns, whose replies reach the sessions that hold the road ahead. /release-notes.
